newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - gas oil up, mogas, LSFO slip.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil up, mogas, LSFO slip.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday ahead of weekly U.S. supply data due out later today.
Naphtha held steady with little concern over Skikda loadings and crude oil prices continuing to trade sideways.
Gasoline edged lower but a noted ARA buyer in the last week resurfaced for a small parcel. No cargo deals were heard done.
Gas oil was boosted by $1.50 on the back of stronger futures. Premiums were steady, with diesel showing continued strength on tight supply.
Low sulphur fuel oil slipped again, on the back of falls in the paper market and cargo deals into Italy at new lows.
NWE physical prices were at $85/$86 fob. High sulphur barges traded at $81 and $81.50 fob ARA.
